set.body:
Purpose

Keep effect_relation pure while composing estimated signal with the information needed to construct and calibrate metrics.

Contract

relation_fit contains a validated effect_relation plus an error-model capability. The initial GLM adapter exposes the effect map, effect-coordinate covariance convention, QR-based residual block provider or sufficient-statistic provider, residual df, sampling units, observation-whitener identity, stable source revisions, and estimator provenance.

Acceptance

- lm_extractor's ambiguous whiten argument is replaced by observation_whitener with a deliberate compatibility policy.
- Raw-response and precomputed-effect routes produce identical relation blocks.
- Residual blocks agree with direct QR residualization without materializing an observation residualizer.
- The separable Sigma tensor V model is one named capability with assumptions and scale convention, not the universal relation definition.
- A relation without an error channel remains valid but cannot request learned metrics or within-participant calibration.
- Deep validation occurs on construction/deserialization, not on every block read.
set.title: Epic 3: Add relation_fit and blockwise error-source contracts
